description: This file defines the CustomField model class within the Opencart platform, responsible for retrieving custom field data from the database, including specific fields and field collections filtered by customer groups or specific custom field IDs.
external_files: Database tables: custom_field, custom_field_description, custom_field_value, custom_field_value_description, custom_field_customer_group

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: A model class for handling custom field retrieval operations within the Opencart platform, extending the system's base Model class.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves a single custom field record from the database by its ID, including description data filtered by the current language.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves all custom fields, optionally filtered by customer group ID, including associated values for select, radio, and checkbox field types.
